scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate: npm run resolve:bindings && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate && npm run build && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 database holding vehicles, loans, protocols, users and the audit log.

KV.description: KV namespace for login sessions and the settings cache.

MEDIA.description: R2 bucket for photos, signatures and generated PDF protocols.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Leave empty: the app records its own URL on the first-run setup screen. Set it only when you attach a custom domain (e.g. `https://fleet.example.com`).

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional. Sender address for invitations, password resets and protocol copies; can also be set later in the app under Settings → E-mail. Its domain must be onboarded under **Compute → Email Service → Email Sending**.

EMAIL_ENABLED.description: `true` to send e-mail through Cloudflare Email Service, `false` to run without e-mail (temporary passwords are then shown on screen).

PBKDF2_ITERATIONS.description: Password hashing cost. Keep `20000` on the Workers Free plan (10 ms CPU limit); up to `100000` on a paid plan.
